description: Fetch a public URL and return its main content as clean Markdown (navigation, scripts, footers removed; links absolutized), plus title, final URL and an estimated token count, truncated to max_tokens. Cheaper on context than raw HTML.

max_tokens.description: Truncate output to about this many tokens (default 8000, max 50000)

name: read_page
title: Read a web page as clean Markdown (with token count)
